title: Distributed Consensus and Raft Protocol
short_description: Understanding leader election, log replication, and safety guarantees in distributed consensus systems.
trend_reason: Fundamental for designing reliable microservices, distributed databases, and stateful workloads.

title: Vector Database Hybrid Search Architecture
short_description: Combining dense vector embeddings with sparse keyword search (BM25) and metadata filtering for accurate retrieval.
trend_reason: High demand in modern LLM retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and semantic search applications.

title: Zero Trust Architecture and Microsegmentation
short_description: Implementing identity-based access controls, continuous verification, and network microsegmentation to limit blast radiuses.
trend_reason: Critical paradigm shift away from perimeter-based security toward robust internal threat mitigation.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Prevention
short_description: Identifying and remediating SSRF vulnerabilities through strict URL parsing, allowlisting, and network isolation.
trend_reason: Increasingly common attack vector targeting cloud metadata services and internal microservices APIs.

title: Vector Index Quantization and Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN)
short_description: Techniques like Product Quantization (PQ) and Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs for scaling high-dimensional similarity searches.
trend_reason: Essential for reducing memory footprints and query latency in billion-scale vector indices.

title: Distributed Transaction Management with Saga Pattern
short_description: Managing data consistency across microservices using choreographed or orchestrated compensating transactions.
trend_reason: Ubiquitous architectural challenge when migrating away from monolithic ACID transactions in distributed systems.
